title.zh: HTX与英国FCA达成和解，停止向英国消费者推广并退出英国市场
title.en: HTX settles with UK FCA, halting UK promotions and exiting the market

current_state.zh: HTX agreed to FCA court undertakings barring it from promoting crypto services to UK consumers until October 2031, having already blocked UK deposits and new registrations.
current_state.en: HTX agreed to FCA court undertakings barring it from promoting crypto services to UK consumers until October 2031, having already blocked UK deposits and new registrations.
